title: Law to create residential parking permits in East Elmhurst
summary: This bill would require the city's Transportation Department to set up a residential parking permit system for East Elmhurst in Queens. The system must reserve at least 20% of spaces for non-residents with short-term parking of at least 90 minutes and exempt certain vehicles, while permit rules would not apply on commercially zoned streets. The law would take effect 120 days after enactment.
